name: Home page
hides: Hides the recommended feed on YouTube's home page and asks "What are you here for?", pointing to YouTube's search, with links to Subscriptions, Watch later and History.

choices.name: Ask me first
choices.hint: “What are you here for?”, no feed

name: Hide recommendations
hides: Hides the suggested videos beside and below the video you're watching, and gives the video the room they leave. Playlists, live chat, chapters and transcripts stay.

name: Hide end screens
hint: The video grid as a video ends
hides: Hides the grid of videos and the info cards that appear at the end of a video.

name: Stop autoplay
hides: Turns YouTube's autoplay off, so the next video doesn't start by itself. The autoplay button still works, and playlists still play in order.

name: Hide comments
hides: Hides the comments below the video you're watching.

name: Hide Shorts
hides: Hides Shorts shelves, the Shorts link in the menu, Shorts in search and a channel's Shorts; a link to a Short still opens.

name: Play Shorts as videos
hint: No swipe feed: the normal player
hides: Turns every Short into a normal video: it opens in the normal player, not the Shorts swipe feed.

name: Clean up search
hides: Hides the shelves in search results, such as "People also watched" and Shorts, and keeps every result.

name: Hide Explore and Trending
hides: Hides Explore, Trending and Playables from YouTube's menu, with the whole Explore section (Music, Gaming, News, Sports and the rest).

name: Hide the notifications bell
hides: Hides the notifications bell and its red count.
